prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic wide-angle interior portrait inside a vintage American muscle car during golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long tousled honey-blonde hair, warm fair skin, confident calm gaze, wearing a black opaque puff-sleeve knee-length dress and chunky black lace-up boots.
prompt.composition_elements: Comfortably reclined across the front seats, one leg naturally extended toward the camera without body emphasis, hand touching hair or shielding eyes, wood-rimmed steering wheel, black vinyl dashboard, chrome accents, ranch fence and blue sky outside.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard warm golden-hour sunlight creates distinct shadow lines across the cabin, Kodak Portra-inspired warm grade, rich blacks, realistic leather and skin texture, indie road-trip mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Wide 24–28mm lens, f/5.6, eye-level seated perspective, deep contextual focus, 35mm film grain and realistic perspective.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cinematic wide-angle interior portrait of an approved adult woman lounging comfortably inside a vintage 1960s/70s American muscle car during golden hour. She has long volumetric sun-kissed honey-blonde hair, warm fair skin, and a confident calm gaze. She wears a black opaque puff-sleeve knee-length dress and chunky black lace-up boots. She reclines across the front seats with one leg naturally extended toward the camera and one knee bent, without body emphasis, while one hand touches her hair or shields her eyes. Include a vintage wood-rimmed three-spoke steering wheel, black vinyl dashboard, chrome accents, ranch-style fence, blue sky, and rearview mirror. Use hard warm sunlight, distinct interior shadows, Kodak Portra-inspired grade, 24–28mm lens, f/5.6, realistic leather and skin, and 35mm grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, mini dress, sweetheart neckline, exposed thighs emphasis, sexualized lounging, nudity, unverified brand logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
